items.title: State Nomination
items.desc: +5 points. Permanent residency from day one. Employment not mandatory. Better option if you are not yet working in regional Victoria.

items.title: Skilled Independent
items.desc: No regional commitment. No nomination required. Live anywhere in Australia from day one. Best for profiles at 90+ points.

items.title: Employer Sponsored
items.desc: Bypasses the points queue entirely. No regional living requirement. If you have 1+ year of experience and a willing employer, this avoids the nomination system altogether.
